correctness.rationale: The Hintikka three-round recurrence reconstructs each sentence type as a set of pointed types, each pointed type as a set of pair relation plus 16-bit third-flat masks. Four-region cell counts and zero/full/interior statuses compute pair masks exactly, with proper flat cardinality <r and the top treated separately. The critical universal endpoint-profile reduction for r>=6 has breakpoints at a=0,1,2 and co-rank 1,2,3, and n-r=0/>0; PROFILES.json gives full Boolean and truncated masks. Explicit rank-three separators follow by isolating complete pointed types. Direct independently written enumeration of literal flat subsets for canonical pairs r<=7 recovers 11 signatures and 121-flat representative; this is corroboration, not the proof of all ranks.
residual_risks: Universal integer-interval endpoint reduction is condensed in the written proof; a machine-certified algebraic elimination for all r is not supplied.
